heading: Limitations on sale of other mercuric-oxide batteries

tree.heading: Prohibition
tree.text: On or after May 13, 1996, no person shall sell, offer for sale, or offer for promotional purposes a mercuric-oxide battery for use in the United States unless the battery manufacturer, or the importer of such a battery—

children.text: identifies a collection site in the United States that has all required Federal, State, and local government approvals, to which persons may send used mercuric-oxide batteries for recycling or proper disposal;
informs each of its purchasers of mercuric-oxide batteries of the collection site identified under paragraph (1); and

informs each of its purchasers of mercuric-oxide batteries of a telephone number that the purchaser may call to get information about sending mercuric-oxide batteries for recycling or proper disposal.

tree.heading: Application of section
tree.text: This section does not apply to a sale or offer of a mercuric-oxide button cell battery.

ancestors.heading: MANAGEMENT OF RECHARGEABLE BATTERIES AND BATTERIES CONTAINING MERCURY
